title_en: Nanshan District People's Procuratorate of Shenzhen, Guangdong Province v. Wang Jianghao — misappropriation of funds
ruling_gist_en: Where the owners' committee of a residential community registers with the market supervision and administration department and obtains an organization code certificate, it conforms to the characteristics of "other units" as defined in the judicial interpretation on similar duty-related crimes, and falls within the scope of "other units" as the victim unit. Accordingly, the staff members of the owners' committee may become the subject of the crime of misappropriation of funds. If the owners' committee opens a basic deposit account in a bank, the funds in that account are owned by all owners, and the owners' committee has its own property; therefore, the funds in the bank account under the name of the owners' committee shall be regarded as "funds of the unit." Where a staff member of the owners' committee, by taking advantage of his or her position, misappropriates the funds of the owners' committee for personal use, for profit-making activities, or for lending to others, and the amount is relatively large and has not been repaid within three months, the offender shall be convicted and punished for the crime of misappropriation of funds in accordance with Article 272, paragraph 1, of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.

full_text_en:
Guangdong Province Shenzhen City Nanshan District People's Procuratorate v. Wang Jianghao — Misappropriation of Funds

Ruling Summary

Where a community业主委员会 registers with the market supervision and administration department and obtains an organization code certificate, meeting the characteristics of "other entities" as stipulated in judicial interpretations of similar duty-related crimes, and falls within the category of "other entities" as the victim entity, the staff of the业主委员会 may become the subject of the crime of misappropriation of funds. The业主委员会 opens a basic deposit account with a bank, and the funds in the account are co-owned by all owners. The业主委员会 has its own property, and the funds in the bank account under the name of the业主委员会 shall be regarded as "funds of the entity". Where a staff member of the业主委员会, taking advantage of their position, misappropriates funds of the业主委员会 for personal use, uses them for profit-making activities or lends them to others, in a relatively large amount, and fails to repay them for more than three months, they shall be convicted and punished for the crime of misappropriation of funds in accordance with the provisions of Article 272, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.

Prosecutorial Authority: Guangdong Province Shenzhen City Nanshan District People's Procuratorate.

Defendant: Wang Jianghao, male, 38 years old, Han nationality, residing in Nanshan District, Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province. He was arrested on July 15, 2016 in connection with this case, released on bail pending trial on September 27, 2016, and placed under residential surveillance on March 5, 2018.

The Guangdong Province Shenzhen City Nanshan District People's Procuratorate initiated a public prosecution in the Guangdong Province Shenzhen City Nanshan District People's Court against the defendant Wang Jianghao for the crime of misappropriation of funds.

The indictment stated that the defendant Wang Jianghao was the director of the second session of the Owners' Committee of Langjingyuan Community, Dachong Subdistrict, Nanshan District, Shenzhen City. In December 2015, Wang Jianghao, without authorization, transferred RMB 440,000 from the public account of the Owners' Committee at the bank to his personal account at China Merchants Bank, of which RMB 400,000 was used for equity investment and RMB 40,000 was transferred as a loan to another person. In May 2016, Wang Jianghao transferred RMB 440,000 back to the Owners' Committee's bank account. The prosecutorial authority claimed that the defendant Wang Jianghao, by taking advantage of his position, misappropriated funds of the entity for personal use and for lending to others, in a relatively large amount, for more than three months without repayment, and used them for profit-making activities. His conduct violated Article 272, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and should be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of misappropriation of funds.

The Guangdong Province Shenzhen City Nanshan District People's Court found the following facts at first instance:

On June 10, 2014, the second session of the Owners' Committee of Langjingyuan Community, Dachong Subdistrict, Nanshan District, Shenzhen City (hereinafter referred to as the "Owners' Committee") was established with the organization code 32654484-1. The defendant Wang Jianghao was elected as the director of the second session of the Owners' Committee, with a term ending on June 9, 2017. On March 6, 2015, Wang Jianghao, in the name of the second session of the Owners' Committee of Langjingyuan Community, opened a public account (account number: 771xxxxxx054) with Bank of China, Gaoxin Sub-branch, to collect fees voluntarily paid by community owners for parking lot equipment, operation and maintenance costs, community property repair fees, and rent for shop fronts. From December 1 to 8, 2015, Wang Jianghao, without discussion and voting at the owners' meeting, personally transferred a total of RMB 440,000 in nine transactions from the public account at Bank of China of the second session of the Owners' Committee of Langjingyuan Community to his personal account at China Merchants Bank (account number: 5240xxxxxxxx9933). On December 8, 2015, he transferred RMB 400,000 thereof to He Chao's account at China Merchants Bank (account number: 6226xxxxxxxx0461) for a 2% equity investment in Shenzhen Chuangda Yunrui Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd., and lent the remaining RMB 40,000 to Li Mei, a member of the Owners' Committee. On May 20, 2016, because community owners demanded a financial audit of the community's accounts, Wang Jianghao transferred a total of RMB 440,000 in nine transactions from his other China Merchants Bank account (account number: 4682xxxxxxxx7539) to the public account at Bank of China of the second session of the Owners' Committee of Langjingyuan Community.

During the trial, the defendant Wang Jianghao had no objection to the above facts but argued that his conduct did not constitute a crime. The reasons were: 1. Although he misappropriated funds without authorization from the owners' meeting, the director of the Owners' Committee does not satisfy the subject elements for the crime of misappropriation of funds; 2. His use of funds from the public account of the community Owners' Committee was for the purpose of financial management, lacking the subjective intent for the crime of misappropriation of funds; 3. Investigating his criminal liability for the crime of misappropriation of funds violated the principle of legality.

The above facts are confirmed by the following evidence submitted by the prosecutorial authority and authenticated through court proceedings: documentary evidence including the acceptance form for criminal cases, decision to file a case, record of arrest, archival materials, organization code certificate of the Owners' Committee, meeting rules, meeting minutes, announcements, letters of notification, bank account opening information and transaction records, labor contracts, statements of circumstances, and identification materials of the defendant, issued by the public security authorities; testimony of witnesses Chen Shuncai, He Chao, Huang Renchao, Li Mei, Xiao Cuiyu, and Jia Qiulei; and the confession and defense of the defendant Wang Jianghao. The evidence is sufficient to establish the facts.

The Guangdong Province Shenzhen City Nanshan District People's Court held at first instance:

The defendant Wang Jianghao, as the director of the Owners' Committee, taking advantage of his position, misappropriated RMB 440,000 in funds of the Owners' Committee for personal use, used them for profit-making activities or lent them to others, in a relatively large amount, and failed to repay them for more than three months. His conduct constituted the crime of misappropriation of funds. The Owners' Committee of Langjingyuan Community had obtained an organization code certificate from the Shenzhen Market Supervision Administration, and thus should be regarded as an "other entity" within the meaning of Article 272 of the Criminal Law, and the staff of the Owners' Committee may be the subject of the crime of misappropriation of funds. The Owners' Committee opened an account with a bank, and the funds in the account are collective property of all owners, and should be recognized as "funds of the entity" within the meaning of Article 272 of the Criminal Law. After being brought to justice, Wang Jianghao truthfully confessed his crime, and had returned the involved funds before the case was initiated, and thus may be given a lighter punishment according to law.

Accordingly, the Guangdong Province Shenzhen City Nanshan District People's Court, in accordance with Article 272, Paragraph 1 and Article 67, Paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, and after discussion and decision by the Adjudication Committee of the court, rendered a judgment on August 16, 2018:

The defendant Wang Jianghao is convicted of the crime of misappropriation of funds and sentenced to nine months' imprisonment.

After the judgment was pronounced at first instance, the defendant Wang Jianghao appealed to the Guangdong Province Shenzhen City Intermediate People's Court. The grounds for appeal were as follows: 1. Current laws and judicial interpretations do not list the director of a community Owners' Committee as an "other entity personnel" for the crime of misappropriation of funds, and thus he does not satisfy the subject elements for that crime; 2. The provisions on "other entity personnel" in judicial interpretations related to the crime of embezzlement are not applicable to the crime of misappropriation of funds; 3. The provisions on "other entities" in judicial interpretations related to commercial bribery crimes are not applicable to the crime of misappropriation of funds; 4. Many community owners expressed forgiveness and granted supplementary authorization.

After the second instance, the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court confirmed the facts found at first instance.

The Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court held at second instance that the appellant Wang Jianghao, without discussion and voting at the owners' meeting, personally misappropriated RMB 440,000 from the public account at Bank of China of the Owners' Committee of Langjingyuan Community, which is an objective fact. Even if some community owners later expressed forgiveness and granted supplementary authorization, this cannot be equated with the prescribed procedure of prior discussion and voting at the owners' meeting. Therefore, subsequent forgiveness or supplementary authorization by the owners has no substantive effect of precluding the finding of illegality. Regarding whether the appellant Wang Jianghao satisfied the subject elements for the crime of misappropriation of funds, the original judgment's reasoning for finding that Wang Jianghao satisfied those subject elements was well-founded, and the conclusion was established according to law and should be adopted.

Accordingly, the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court, in accordance with Article 236, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered a ruling on December 6, 2018:

The appeal is dismissed, and the original judgment is affirmed.

This ruling is final.
